evidence.task_manager_video_decode_source: WDDM/D3DKMT interfaces tracking DXVA/DirectX Video Acceleration

subagent_5_task_manager_correlation.explanation: Task Manager's 'Video Decode' graph monitors DXVA usage (Windows Media Foundation, DirectX VA). FFmpeg's cuvid/NVDEC path bypasses DXVA entirely, using CUDA context directly. The '3D' graph shows CUDA compute activity (SCRFD inference kernels). NVDEC activity is NOT visible in Task Manager on this GPU/driver combination.

fps_validation.note: Source/Decode/Ingestion FPS are equal (25.3) because they measure the same loop iteration rate. AI/Output FPS are lower (7.5) because AI processing is the bottleneck. The soak test FPS counters for decode/ingestion/AI/output all increment once per loop iteration and do NOT measure actual stage throughput independently.

ai_fps_validation.note: Throughput FPS (7.5) != 1000/mean_latency (8.3) due to serial processing and queue effects.

serial_vs_concurrent.queue_behavior: No queue between decode and AI - synchronous blocking
serial_vs_concurrent.note: Both cameras processed sequentially in same thread. No overlap between CAM1 and CAM2 inference.
